newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-CRUYFF LOSES SLANDER CASE AGAINST BARCELONA PRESIDENT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CRUYFF LOSES SLANDER CASE AGAINST BARCELONA PRESIDENT.

text.p: Former Barcelona coach Johan Cruyff lost a legal battle against club president Jose Luis Nunez on Tuesday in which he had claimed defamation of character.
Cruyff lodged the law suit in response to comments Nunez made at a heated news conference the day after Barcelona sacked the Dutchman last May.
Nunez had accused Cruyff of selling his support to candidates in club elections, selling information to the media and favouring his son Jordi over other players in the squad.
But a judge said on Tuesday Nunez's criticisms were made against Cruyff's performance as a manager rather than against him as an individual.
Nunez's decision to call the news conference was compared to that of a businessman who has to explain why he has fired an employee.
The judge also turned down Cruyff's request that Nunez should not be allowed to make further comments about him.
Cruyff's lawyer Damian Tellez hit out at the decision, saying "Nunez committed a foul but a penalty wasn't given".
